skill.summary: Generate stunning traditional Chinese ink paintings (shui-mo hua) and sumi-e brushwork art with AI. Create classical shan shui landscapes, bamboo, koi, drago...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Chinese Ink Painting Generator.
- Generate traditional Chinese ink paintings and sumi-e art using the Neta AI image generation API.
- Supports a range of styles including landscapes, bamboo, koi, dragons, plum blossoms, calligraphy, zen minimalist, and Japanese ink wash.
- Customizable options for image size and style reference.
- Requires a free Neta API token for image generation.
